structured_output.summary: The change implements Proxy [[Get]] step by step. It validates the proxy, gets the "get" trap with GetMethod, and forwards to target.[[Get]] when the trap is undefined. It calls the trap with (target, key, receiver) and then calls target.[[GetOwnProperty]]. It enforces both invariants: SameValue for a non-writable, non-configurable data property, and undefined for a non-configurable accessor with no getter. Every fallible operation is propagated with `?`. Each step has its spec comment directly above its code. The gate report shows 38 of 38 target tests passing, with no regressions and no lint flags. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors or unrelated edits. The only incidental edits are dropping the NOTE comment and renaming `o` to `_o`, both harmless.
